topic: remove a key that snapped off inside a lock
core_question: How do I get a broken key piece out of a lock?
answer_summary: Insert a broken key extractor tool (or two fine hook picks) alongside the snapped key fragment and gently pull it out along the pins, without pushing it deeper.
persona: tired and blunt; using casual slang
